# Weligama Bay Marriott Development Record

> A factual, full-cycle record of originating, financing, designing, constructing, operating and exiting a 198-key Marriott resort in Weligama, Sri Lanka.

Canonical site: https://marriott.viji.com/
Language: English

## Project record

- [Home](https://marriott.viji.com/): Introduction to the complete hotel development record.
- [Overview](https://marriott.viji.com/overview): Project scope, capital structure, delivery sequence, operating performance and transaction outcome.
- [Opportunity](https://marriott.viji.com/opportunity): Market, product and beachfront-site thesis before acquisition and design.
- [Development](https://marriott.viji.com/development): Coastal search, land assembly, acquisition, operator engagement and capital formation.
- [Design](https://marriott.viji.com/design): Architecture, operating requirements, area planning and Marriott standards.
- [Construction](https://marriott.viji.com/construction): Delivery control, specialist coordination, infrastructure, procurement and commissioning.
- [Operations](https://marriott.viji.com/operations): Mobilisation, opening, demand development and stabilised operating performance.
- [Exit](https://marriott.viji.com/exit): The 19 April 2019 share sale, valuation and operator continuity.
- [Lessons](https://marriott.viji.com/lessons): Specific changes that would inform the structure of a future development.
- [Library](https://marriott.viji.com/library): Curated project records with evidence and access classifications.

## Verified project facts

- Location: Weligama, Sri Lanka
- Hotel inventory: 198 keys
- Total development cost: USD 42 million
- Stabilised occupancy: 75%
- Stabilised average daily rate: USD 155
- Stabilised gross operating profit margin: 38%
- Exit date: 19 April 2019
- Transaction structure: Share sale
- Enterprise value: USD 57 million
- Operator following the transaction: Marriott International

## Source and interpretation notes

- The site distinguishes verified figures from narrative or reported figures.
- The reported 120% ROI is not presented as independently reconciled because detailed equity cash-flow schedules are unavailable.
- The transaction predates later disruption in Sri Lanka; the record does not claim those events were anticipated.
